gh release create v<version> --draft --t.how: Against a private test repo: creates a draft with no tag yet, printing .../releases/tag/untagged-...

gh release download v<previous-version>.how: With gh 2.101.0 and weaver 0.28.0, in a checkout of a published registry after make package with no changes since that release (packaged with weaver 0.26.1): no output, exit 0

gh release list --json tagName,isDraft -.how: Against a test repo, after the draft is created: prints v<version>

gh run list --workflow \"@@CI_WORKFLOW_N.how: With the full 40-character sha: shows the commit's CI run; with a short sha: prints nothing, exit 0

gh run list --workflow release.yml --lim.how: With gh 2.101.0, in a checkout of a repo that has run the Release workflow: one line for the newest run

gh run watch <run-id> --exit-status.how: Against a test repo's release run: follows the run, exits 0 when it succeeds and non-zero when it fails

gh workflow run release.yml --ref <defau.how: Against a test repo: dispatches the Release workflow and prints the run URL, its ID last

git log --oneline v<previous-version>..o.how: With git 2.54.0, in a checkout of a published registry: lists the commits touching the registry since that release

git ls-remote --tags <repo-url> 'v*'.how: With git 2.54.0, against a published registry's repo: one line per v* tag

git rev-parse origin/<default-branch>.how: Prints the full 40-character sha that gh run list --commit needs
